description.narrative:
RISEE is a community based organization seeking to launch a Coffee value addition project. The project is entirely a youth led initiative designed to revolutionize the coffee supply chain in rural Uganda. By establishing a comprehensive processing facility, we are transitioning local farmers from selling low value red cherries to high quality roasted coffee. The plant provides an integrated suite of services in coffee processing, that not only eliminates dependence on the unreliable fuel heavy local mills and by pass exploitative middlemen but also empowers marginalized youth. This ensures the value added profits are retained in the community.
The goal is to establish a 100% youth led roasting facility that increases rural household incomes by shifting from raw cherry sales to high value roasted coffee.
Objectives: 1. Provide reliable, integrated processing from pulping to roasting for local farmers 2. Create technical jobs for marginalized youth 3. Secure higher profit for farmers through direct value addition
Activities: 1. Procurement and installation of eco friendly pulpers, hullers and roasters 2. Technical training for youth in coffee processing operations 3. Launching a community processing hub for washing and solar drying 4. Branding and local marketing of the organization's coffee brand.

participating-org.narrative:
Reach the Impoverished with Social-Economic Empowerement is a community based organisation dedicated to breaking the cycle of poverty in rural Uganda.
We empower small holders to transition from subsistence farming to value addition thus increasing the profit margins that earlier would have been lost to middle men and international exporters.
The Organisation's proposed coffee processing plant seeks to replace inefficient gasoline dependent processing with a modern integrated facility that handles the entire value chainfrom pulping and washing, to hulling and roasting.
Vision: To see a transformed rural society where every household is self reliant, food secure and empowered to participate actively in food value chain.
Mission: To uplift impoverished rural communities through provision of affordable value addition infrastructure, technical training and fair market access. This ensures the wealth generated from Uganda's farming sector stays in the hands of producers.
Objectives Value addition: To establish a facility that will shift the community from selling raw cherries to exporting high quality roasted coffee. Economic Empowerment: To eliminate exploitative middle men by proving farmers with tools to process and brand their own coffee. Employment Creation: To generate direct jobs within the plant and indirect opportunities for local youth and women Reliability and Sustainability: To provide a consistent processingalternative to current unreliable fuel dependent mills
Values: Our values include equity, innovation, integrity and community ownership.
